actions.text:
Hi Marcus — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. I’m interested in this analytics dashboard project and the scope you described aligns with my experience. A few quick questions so I can prepare an accurate proposal: 1) Can you share API docs or example endpoints (rate limits, pagination, auth method)? 2) Do you have a preferred charting library (D3.js is fine, I can also recommend alternatives like Recharts or Vega) and any example visual designs? 3) For authentication, do you need full role-based access implemented on the frontend only or coordinated with your backend auth? 4) Are there specific performance or real-time requirements (e.g., max latency, websocket vs polling)? 5) Finally, is the $5k–$6k budget fixed and is the ~4 week timeline flexible? I’m available to hop on a 30-minute call to go over details — I can do Mon–Thu next week between 10am–2pm CT. If that works, let me know a preferred time and I’ll send a calendar invite. Thanks — Jordan Mitchell
